title: Macroscopic Limits and Phase Diagrams of Ferroelectric Models
exact_target: Derive ferroelectric polarization models from microscopic theories and analyze the proposed long-range random-field phase diagram.

Mini-Workshop: Mathematics of Magnetoelastic Materials (2016), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2016/51, pp. 2909--2940. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 25.

status_qualification: The still-open lower-bound direction is expressly part of the first question, and the lead titanate--lead zirconate phase diagram is a second target. The microscopic and effective Hamiltonians are source-defined and are not replaced by a generic Ising model.
